content:
Camille: ok team — quick sync. We have an ISV gateway pilot request from LangChain + a gateway vendor that wants Redwood to validate routing + orchestration flows. Need to define scope, timeline, and an external announcement plan.
Evan: +1. what's the minimal scope we can ship in the pilot?
Camille: aim for: 1) route LLM calls via gateway -> Redwood hosted; 2) run an orchestration flow that falls back to a local lightweight model; 3) collect perf/cost telemetry for a 2-week window.
Priya: sounds right. also want to ensure we test edge cases: model mismatches, kv-cache warmup, and token accounting for split routing.
Mike: on hardware partner side, NVIDIA asked for a validation matrix showing NVLink/quant perf on Dedicated. We should include a short perf doc for them.
Oliver: timeline check — can infra + eng-runtime support this by May 5? that's when LangChain wants to start the pilot.
Evan: May 5 is tight. We can do a soft start: limited traffic and only one orchestration path in week 1, then expand in week 2.
Priya: agree. propose milestones: draft pilot plan by Apr 18, infra readiness by Apr 28, soft start May 5, full run May 12.
Camille: add marketplace/announce gating: marketing needs a checklist for joint customer comms and legal needs to approve co-branding. I'd prefer announcement after full run unless partner insists earlier.
Mike: NVIDIA will want to co-promote once perf numbers look good — we should plan a short NDA-friendly blurb.
Oliver: action items: Evan owns infra tasks, Priya owns test plan + eval prompts, Mike owns partner comms with NVIDIA, Camille will coordinate LangChain and marketing.
Evan: infra quick note: we need a staging gateway endpoint and a mapping rule in smart-routing. Example config we'll use for the pilot: 
```
route: /generate
policy: prefer-low-latency
fallback: local-quantized-variant
logging: trace, kv-cache-stats=true
```
Camille: good — include that snippet in the pilot doc. Also, we should capture contract points for the gateway vendor: auth, rate limits, and compatible model variants.
Priya: tests I'll run: cold-start latency, prefix-cache effectiveness, token billing verification, and hallucination rate on standard eval set. Will post prompts later.
Mike: marketing ask: if we hit target perf (latency < 120ms p50, cost delta < 1.2x) we can draft a joint blog + tweet. Legal: please hold any logos until compliance signs off.
Camille: copy. Last thing — can someone schedule a 30m kickoff with LangChain + gateway vendor for Apr 20? I'd like both engineering and partnerships on the call.
Evan: I'll book Apr 20 10am PT, invite list: Camille, Evan, Priya, Mike, Oliver, LangChain-SME, Gateway-PM.
deploy-bot: reminder: created calendar event "ISV gateway pilot kickoff" scheduled Apr 20 10:00 PT.
Camille: perfect. I'll start the pilot doc in the partnership drive and ping this thread with the link. :tada:
